_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. factory.com declares its design-token layer in the served Next.js CSS bundles (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and a [data-theme]-switching semantic layer emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each scope resolves its own value. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match. The auth.factory.ai sign-in is outside this layer; its values are measured literals under component.signin.*.
